subject: Coordination: narrow-window demo for US prospect with EU engineering
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@midtownhealth.com>, Kelly Rivera <kelly.r@midtownhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 16:40:00 -0400
Subject: Narrow-window demo — US customer + EU eng team (quick options)

Hi Alex / Kelly —

Thanks again for your time on the discovery call. Midtown Health sounds like a great fit for our latency-sensitive inference use case. To keep momentum I want to lock a working demo date where our EU engineering pair (Marcus / Hannah) can join live. I know this is a narrow window (US morning vs EU evening) — proposing two quick options that are easiest for our teams: 

Option A (US-early / EU-late):
  - 07:30 PT / 10:30 ET / 15:30 GMT / 16:30 CEST — runs ~45–60 min
Option B (US-late / EU-morning):
  - 20:00 PT / 23:00 ET / 03:00 BST(+1 day) / 04:00 CEST(+1 day) — less ideal for us but possible with rotation

One more note: there is a DST offset this week where EU moves clocks a day before the US — that will shift the conversion by one hour for ~10 days; I've attached a quick matrix showing the week-of options.

Can you confirm whether Option A (10:30 ET) is doable for Midtown? If so we'll assign Marcus + Hannah as hosts and share the agenda and invite. If not, tell me a couple of windows and we will try to accommodate.

Attachments: timezone_matrix.csv, redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf (draft)

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0198

-----
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@midtownhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>
Cc: Kelly Rivera <kelly.r@midtownhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 18:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Narrow-window demo — US customer + EU eng team (quick options)

Connor —

Thanks — Option A (10:30 ET) looks promising for our product team. Would 10:30 ET / 16:30 CEST work for your engineers? The earlier slot is preferable so our VP can join before afternoon clinics.

Two asks:
- Can you make sure an engineer who can speak to API latency and token throughput is on the call? We sometimes go deep on perf.
- If the EU host times out (late evening), can you record the session or provide a backup host from your US team?

If you confirm, I'll push the calendar invite out from calendar@midtownhealth.com.

Best,
Alex Johnson
Director, Product — Midtown Health
alex.j@midtownhealth.com
(212) 555-0123

Alex / Connor —

10:30 ET / 16:30 CEST works for us on our side — I (Marcus) will be the primary host and Hannah will handle the live instrumentation and traces. A couple of logistics so we're aligned:

- API engineer: Priya will be on the thread and has availability for the 16:30 CEST slot to present throughput/quantization tradeoffs.
- DST note: EU clocks jump forward on Sun 28 Mar; US moves the following week. For meetings scheduled in the week that crosses these dates the ET<->CEST mapping can shift by 1 hour. I attached a small matrix (timezone_matrix.csv) to make that explicit — we'll double-check the calendar invite time when you publish it.
- Backup plan: If EU-host availability becomes constrained at the late end-of-day we'll rotate hosting to our US support engineer (Hannah can hand off). We can also record and share the recording + short perf notes.

If Alex/Kelly confirm, Priya / Hannah / I will lock in the demo agenda and calendar event (I'll volunteer to monitor the invite to catch the DST drift).

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference

Connor / Marcus —

10:30 ET is OK for us. Alex asked that an engineer be prepared to field API/perf Qs and that the session be recorded (we have clinicians joining who can't stay late).

Please include the recording link in the invite and drop any pre-read or run-of-show in the calendar description. If there's any risk of the EU host timing out because of the DST change, please push the backup US host in the invite as optional.

I'll wait for the official invite from calendar@midtownhealth.com.

Thanks,
Kelly Rivera
Senior Program Manager — Midtown Health
kelly.r@midtownhealth.com
